mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.name,o.org_type,o.status,om.role FROM organization_member om JOIN organization o ON o.id=om.organization_id WHERE om.user_id=#{userId} AND om.status='ACTIVE' AND o.status='ACTIVE' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY o.id,om.id

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM organization_member om JOIN organization o ON o.id=om.organization_id WHERE om.user_id=#{userId} AND om.role='SYSTEM_ADMIN' AND om.status='ACTIVE' AND o.org_type='SYSTEM' AND o.status='ACTIVE' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL )
